_doc: M96 EYE SPEC (96px figure, palette v2/pixelize/palette.json). Source of truth for eyes/mouths/blush of masters, head stamps and animated frames. Code: v2/m96/tools/eyes.py (templates, mirror, detect, stamp, check); checker CLI v2/m96/tools/eyecheck.py. See EYE_SPEC.md.

legend.@: CATCHLIGHT (rendered W): 1x2 px, iris column 2 (inset), top two iris rows; with the 1x2 K pupil at iris column 3 just right of it; same screen-space position in every eye/view/expression (iris is never mirrored)
legend.W: sclera (only where the template has it)
skin (eye box is cleared to skin first)

front_left._doc: near/left eye in screen space, 6 cols x 6 rows: brow row (only skin marks touched) + lash row + 3 iris rows + 1 empty row (no lower lid, no grey under-row: both read as eye bags). c0 = outer lash wing (row 2), c1-c4 = iris. IRIS (identical in every eye, never mirrored): h top row, g sides, L light bottom (inside the eye), K pupil 1px at iris col 3 (row 2), CATCHLIGHT '@' = 1x2 W at iris col 2 (top two iris rows, inset). Right eye = eyetmpl.mirror() mirrors only the lash/wing geometry; SE far eye = front_right cols 1,2,3,5; E uses front_left.

mouth._doc: 4 cols x 3 rows (cheek, mouth, jaw rows) at the anchor 'mouth' origin. m line, R open interior (no K ring), k tongue. Every mark has a same-colour 8-neighbour (qc orphan rule).

blush._doc: k px per visible cheek (far cheek max 2; NE 1 px x 2 rows), on the row under the eye block (lash row + 5). Always >= 2 px (qc orphan rule) and present in the neutral master (qc: stamps may not add colours absent from the master head); embarrassed adds a 2nd row

ne_lash._doc: NE: only the lash tip pokes past the cheek outline (px count, stacked upward from the lash row)

rules: One construction everywhere: thin K lash row + wing one row lower at the outer corner; iris 4x3: h top, g sides, L light bottom, K pupil 1px (iris col 3, row 2), W catchlight 1x2 (iris col 2, rows 1-2); nothing below the iris (a lid or grey row read as eye bags).
Catchlight: 1x2 W at iris column 2, top two iris rows, pupil right next to it; identical in both eyes, all views, all expressions, mirrored frames (the iris block is never mirrored).
Eye vertical position: lash row = head crown row + eye_dy (eye_dy identical for S and SE; E/NE per anchor JSON).
Expressions change only lash/lid/brow rows; whenever the iris is visible it is this iris + catchlight.
Iris colour = the illustration's grey-brown: palette h #342126 / g #5e4a45 / L #85706a (eyes material).

Open-eye expressions keep the neutral iris + catchlight pixels exactly (qc stamps rule); expressions change only lash/brow/lid rows, mouth and blush; closed/squint expressions (joy, blink_closed, effort, pain) drop the iris.

kinds_by_view._doc: left-to-right in screen space; mirrored views (W/SW/NW) use mirrored kinds, the catchlight stays top-left

front_right_override._doc: hand-mirrored right eyes where the lid slope must mirror but the catchlight column may not
